s1.heading: 1. Who we are
s1.body: Link Charts is a free URL shortening service with analytics, operated by Bruno Cordeiro. We are the controller of your personal data under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law 13.709/2018) and applicable international privacy regulations. Contact: <mailLink>linkcharts@gmail.com</mailLink>.

s2.heading: 2. Data we collect
s2.intro: We collect the following categories of data when you use Link Charts:

clicks.label: Click data
clicks.text: date, time, country of origin, device type, browser, and operating system of each visitor who accesses your links.

ip.label: IP address
ip.text: used for approximate geolocation (country/region) and abuse protection.

cookies.label: Cookies and identifiers
cookies.text: language preference, authenticated session, and — with your consent — analytics and advertising cookies.

account.label: Account data
account.text: name and email address, if you create an account.

platform.label: Platform operation
platform.text: (shortening, redirect, account): contract performance — art. 7, V.

analytics.label: Click analytics
analytics.text: (statistics for your links): legitimate interest — art. 7, IX.

ga.label: Google Analytics
ga.text: (browsing behaviour): consent — art. 7, I. Activated only if you accept analytics cookies.

adsense.label: Google AdSense
adsense.text: (advertising): consent — art. 7, I. Activated only if you accept advertising cookies.

s4.heading: 4. Data sharing
s4.intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with the following service providers, for the stated purposes:

adsense.label: Google AdSense (Google LLC)
adsense.text: ad delivery — consent only (ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization).

s5.heading: 5. Your rights (LGPD art. 18)
s5.intro: As a data subject, you have the following rights:
rights: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data
Anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data
Withdrawal of consent at any time
s5.contact: To exercise your rights: <mailLink>linkcharts@gmail.com</mailLink>. Or use the "Do not sell my data" link in the footer to manage your cookie preferences.

s6.heading: 6. International data transfers
s6.body: Google Analytics and Google AdSense process data in the United States. These transfers occur under the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission and equivalent safeguards accepted by Brazil's ANPD.

account.label: Account data
account.text: while the account is active + 30 days after deletion.

s8.heading: 8. Security
s8.body: We use HTTPS for all communications, restricted database access, and periodic permission reviews. No system is 100% secure; in the event of an incident affecting your data, we will notify you as required by applicable law.

s9.heading: 9. California residents' rights (CCPA)
s9.intro: If you reside in California (USA), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants you additional rights:

know.label: Right to know
know.text: what personal data we collect and with whom we share it.

delete.label: Right to delete
delete.text: request deletion of your personal data.

optOut.label: Right to opt out of sale
optOut.text: we do not sell personal data. To disable sharing with advertising partners, use the "Do not sell my data" link in the footer.

nonDiscrimination.label: Right to non-discrimination
nonDiscrimination.text: we do not discriminate against users who exercise their CCPA rights.

s11.heading: 11. Policy updates
s11.body: This policy may be updated. The effective date at the top indicates the current version. Significant changes will be communicated by email to registered users.

s1.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
s1.body: By accessing or using Link Charts, you agree to these Terms of Service and our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

s2.heading: 2. Service description
s2.body: Link Charts is a free URL shortening platform that provides basic click analytics, geolocation, and device data. The service is provided "as is", without warranty of uninterrupted availability. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue features without prior notice.

s3.heading: 3. Acceptable use
s3.intro: It is expressly prohibited to use Link Charts to shorten URLs that contain or lead to:
items: Malware, viruses, ransomware, phishing, or any malicious code
Content that is illegal under Brazilian or international law
Content that infringes copyrights, trademarks, or third-party privacy rights
Content promoting violence, hatred, discrimination, or terrorism

s4.heading: 4. Responsibility for links
s4.body: You are solely responsible for the content of the URLs you shorten. Link Charts does not proactively monitor link content, but reserves the right to remove any link that violates these terms, without prior notice or justification.

s5.heading: 5. User account
s5.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities carried out from your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use: <mailLink>linkcharts@gmail.com</mailLink>.

s6.heading: 6. Limitation of liability
s6.body: Link Charts is not liable for direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use the service, including damages caused by links shortened by third parties. In no event shall our liability exceed the amount paid for the service in the last 12 months (zero, for free use).

s7.heading: 7. Termination
s7.body: We may terminate or suspend your access to the service, with or without notice, for violation of these terms or for any other reason at our discretion. You may close your account at any time through the settings panel or by requesting via email.

s8.heading: 8. Intellectual property
s8.body: The code, design, and content of Link Charts are protected by copyright. Use of the service does not transfer any intellectual property rights. Shortened links and analytics data generated from your links belong to you.

s9.heading: 9. Governing law and jurisdiction
s9.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. Any dispute shall be submitted to the courts of the city of São Paulo, State of São Paulo, to the exclusion of any other, however privileged.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Questions, suggestions, or issues? We're here to help.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.emailText: 📧 Email: <mailLink>linkcharts@gmail.com</mailLink> — we respond within 2 business days.
contact.bugsText: 🐛 Bugs & suggestions: <githubLink>github.com/bcordeirodev</githubLink> — open an issue in the repository.

items.a: Paste any URL into the field on the home page, customise the slug if you wish, and click "Shorten". You'll receive a short link immediately — no account required.

items.q: Do I need an account to use the service?
items.a: No. Basic shortening is free and requires no registration. An account is only needed to access advanced analytics, manage your links, and set custom slugs.

items.q: How can I delete a link I created?
items.a: Log in, go to "My Links" in the main menu, find the link you want, and use the delete option. Links created without an account cannot be deleted later.

items.q: I found a shortened link with malicious content. What should I do?
items.a: Send the full link (including the slug) to linkcharts@gmail.com with the subject line "Link Report". We review and remove abusive links within 24 hours.
